ValidationRule.description: Checks if the ARD is in the past when users move the Status to On Hold.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.SC_BypassValidationRules), ISCHANGED( Status ), ISPICKVAL(Status,"On Hold - Internal"), OR( SC_ActionRequiredDateTime__c <= NOW(), ISBLANK(SC_ActionRequiredDateTime__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please input an ARD in the future before putting the case on hold - internal.
